projects.name: Led end-to-end daily, weekly, and monthly Cash, Position, and Digital Asset
details: reconciliation transformation programme across Custody, Fund Accounting, Middle Office, and AIS for fixed
income, financing, and related products — ensuring completion before trading-hour deadlines across global
regions.
• Lifecycle Management: Managed full project lifecycle including requirement gathering, test strategy
definition (SIT, UAT, regression), milestone tracking, RAID logs, and action item trackers across all
reconciliation workstreams.
• Transformation & Automation: Drove reconciliation automation and AI-enabled capabilities spanning
multiple source systems (FTS, Geneva, GSP, Treasury Edge, Invest One/FIS), reducing operational risk
and manual data load.
• Data Migration: Defined Business Requirement Documents, workflows, and validation criteria for internal
and external data migration to the RDZ platform via NDM/SFTP — aligning with data transformation and
integration best practices.
• Process Improvement: Enabled Feed Advancement (Time Discrepancy) and Unknown Data Cleansing
initiatives, accelerating early reconciliation and NAV calculation for trading teams.
• Team Leadership: Managed and mentored a team of 6 analysts across multiple transformation
workstreams, fostering professional growth and operational excellence.
• Stakeholder Management: Acted as primary liaison between Business, Client, and Technology teams;
managed escalations with custodians on break resolution, trade settlements, and SLA compliance.
• Governance & Reporting: Maintained project artefacts including charters, integrated timelines, and
process flows in JIRA and Confluence; provided regular status updates to senior stakeholders.
• Risk & Compliance: Continually reassessed operational and technology risks in line with regulatory
requirements and governance frameworks.
